Tried to set up a scheduler that would trigger an action. the 'when account usage resets' trigger was selected. for the 'claude' agent and the '5-hour' account usage tracker.

however, nothing happened. Although the account usage indicator clearly showed that the tracker had gone back to 0, no action was started again. so something went wrong, the trigger was not properly detected?

entries.content:
The report does not contain the saved schedule or logs, so I cannot identify the exact failure in that run.

The code shows two relevant issues. When Claude reports **0% used without a reset time**, the scheduler discards that usage observation, so the visible drop to 0 does not itself trigger the action. A separate timer should still start it at the reset time saved when the schedule was created. If starting the action fails, the scheduler marks it failed but discards the error, making the cause hard to see.

I propose detecting the selected tracker’s transition to a new usage window, while retaining the timer as a fallback. The scheduler should also save and report action startup errors. A regression test should cover Claude’s 0% snapshot with no reset time.
